archive_hypotheses.claim: Dynamic Pantheon/Flash/agent selection can produce a robust live edge.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: No costed OOS evidence established a robust edge; complexity made signal attribution and parity expensive.
prohibited: using shadow leaderboard as expectancy evidence

archive_hypotheses.claim: GeneticCore agents can be selected and promoted into Bitget live trading.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: No checkpoint passed the mandatory costed validation and OOS contract; all generated checkpoints were removed.

archive_hypotheses.claim: OI, basis, crowding and funding score predicts a costed six-hour move.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Only 5 policy-allowed trades; mean predicted move 212.17 bps versus realized net -4.33 bps; every exit used max_holding.

archive_hypotheses.claim: A four-hour fixed exit repairs CarryFlow expectancy.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Independent roots produced -18.12 bps mean versus -1.17 bps baseline; v1 and v5 collapsed.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Leave-one-root-out flow features select positive CarryFlow entries.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 27 held-out trades, -0.36 bps mean and -30.37 bps LCB.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Hybrid market and flow features improve held-out CarryFlow entries.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 22 held-out trades, -1.42 bps mean and -39.66 bps LCB; v5 collapsed.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Trading only range-to-trend transitions creates a robust breakout edge.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 8 trades with positive mean but -15.82 bps LCB, one inactive root and v5 collapse.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Regime-filtered hourly pullbacks have positive costed OOS expectancy.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: OOS mean -19.94 bps with direction, regime, drawdown and root collapses.

archive_hypotheses.claim: OHLCV compression transitions have positive costed OOS expectancy.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: OOS mean -9.81 bps and LCB -26.37 bps with direction and root collapses.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Recent Bitget funding carry exceeds the executable cost floor.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: No signal passed: maximum projected carry 7.35 bps versus 16 bps cost floor; historical split coverage is unavailable.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Cross-sectional 4h trend survives costs and uncertainty.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Development means were positive, but LCB, directions, drawdown and baseline comparison failed.

archive_hypotheses.claim: One long/short relative-momentum pair has positive costed edge.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 96 closed pairs, 13.04 bps mean but -74.06 bps LCB and excessive drawdown.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Weekly top-two/bottom-two 4h momentum diversifies pair risk.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 96 portfolios, 50.83 bps mean but -22.99 bps LCB; drawdown and baseline gates failed.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Walk-forward cointegration spreads retain edge after costs.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: 94 trades, 2.57 bps mean, -27.62 bps LCB and -3.43 bps stress mean.

archive_hypotheses.claim: At least one of nine simple strategy families survives one shared simulator and cost model.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Zero of ten preregistered strategies passed; all non-flat OOS means and LCBs were negative.

archive_hypotheses.claim: EMA 12/48 is profitable when positions are restricted to neutral BTC market hours.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Sealed 14-day holdback produced 91 trades, -0.96 bps gross mean, -16.96 bps stress mean, -36.36 bps LCB and negative results in both halves.

archive_hypotheses.claim: EMA 12/48 trades entered in neutral BTC hours preserve the historical regime slice edge.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Exact entry-only diagnostic produced 53 trades, -44.45 bps gross mean, -60.45 bps stress mean, -91.23 bps LCB and negative results in both halves.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Displayed Bitget futures top-of-book spread can cover a non-VIP two-maker-fill roundtrip before queue risk and adverse selection.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Across 621414 full8 depth snapshots, mean displayed spread was 1.07 bps versus a 4 bps fee floor; optimistic mean was -2.93 bps and daily-cluster LCB -3.14 bps.

archive_hypotheses.claim: Three compact microstructure sessions can calibrate spread, depth and execution assumptions.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: Useful for execution calibration and parity checks; approximately 48 hours cannot establish alpha.

archive_hypotheses.claim: The isolated Bitget Freqtrade dry-run can start deterministically without granting live authority.
archive_hypotheses.verdict: NoTrade and deterministic pulse reached RUNNING; dry_run=false pulse startup is rejected.

archive_rules: Create a new registry version before opening a new holdout.
Do not retune a terminal-rejected hypothesis on its revealed OOS.
Use one shared next-bar simulator and one shared fee/slippage contract.
A positive mean without positive LCB is not a candidate.
No research report or dry-run harness grants paper or live authority.
